tasks_agenda_idx.name: tasks_agenda_idx
tasks_agenda_idx.where: "tasks"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "tasks"."long_running" AND "tasks"."kind" <> 'step' AND "tasks"."deleted_at" IS NULL

tasks_tracked_idx.name: tasks_tracked_idx
tasks_tracked_idx.where: "tasks"."status" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."kind" <> 'step' AND "tasks"."deleted_at" IS NULL

tasks_status_matches_actor.name: tasks_status_matches_actor
tasks_status_matches_actor.value: ("tasks"."actor" = 'human' AND ("tasks"."status" IS NULL OR "tasks"."status" IN ('todo', 'toDefine', 'doing', 'inHold', 'done', 'cancel', 'missed'))) OR ("tasks"."actor" = 'agent' AND "tasks"."status" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'waiting', 'done', 'failed', 'cancel'))

tasks_long_running_shape.name: tasks_long_running_shape
tasks_long_running_shape.value: NOT "tasks"."long_running" OR ("tasks"."actor" = 'human' AND "tasks"."status" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."status" <> 'missed' AND "tasks"."recurrence_id" IS NULL)

tasks_long_running_notify.name: tasks_long_running_notify
tasks_long_running_notify.value: NOT "tasks"."long_running" OR "tasks"."estimated_finish_at" IS NOT NULL OR cardinality("tasks"."notify_offsets_minutes") = 0

tasks_block_span.name: tasks_block_span
tasks_block_span.value: "tasks"."long_running" OR "tasks"."started_at" IS NULL OR "tasks"."estimated_finish_at" IS NULL OR ("tasks"."estimated_finish_at" >= "tasks"."started_at" AND "tasks"."estimated_finish_at" - "tasks"."started_at" <= interval '31 days')

tasks_occurrence_requires_day.name: tasks_occurrence_requires_day
tasks_occurrence_requires_day.value: "tasks"."recurrence_id" IS NULL OR "tasks"."occurrence_on" IS NOT NULL
